legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Outpatient pharmacy notification: prescription renewal ready for collection
legitimateControls.text: Dear Patient, the clinical pharmacist has completed the review of your blood pressure and cholesterol medication profile. Your routine tablet prescription is ready for collection at the outpatient clinic dispensary during regular hours. Please bring your photo identification and current medicine list if you would like to discuss dosing instructions with the care team.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Cardiology clinic follow-up and home blood pressure monitoring plan
legitimateControls.text: Following your consultation with the specialist, we have updated your treatment record and medication schedule. Please continue taking your prescribed tablet dose with breakfast and record your daily blood pressure readings in the monitoring diary. Contact the practice nurse or physician if you notice side effects before your next scheduled appointment.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Hospital discharge care summary and antibiotic dosing schedule
legitimateControls.text: This care summary confirms the discharge instructions discussed with the ward physician and clinical pharmacist. Take the prescribed antibiotic medication with food at the scheduled times until the course is finished. Please bring this treatment record to your follow-up consultation at the medical clinic next week.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Annual health plan formulary update and generic prescription coverage
legitimateControls.text: Our benefits administration team reviewed the covered prescription medication list for the upcoming plan year. Your approved generic cholesterol and hypertension treatment remains covered under the clinical formulary. Speak with your prescribing clinician or community pharmacist at your next consultation if you have questions about equivalent tablet options.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Laboratory blood test reminder and clinic appointment confirmation
legitimateControls.text: You are scheduled for a routine fasting lipid panel and metabolic blood test at the medical clinic on Tuesday at 08:30 AM. Please drink only water for twelve hours before the appointment and take your regular morning medication unless instructed otherwise by your physician.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Monthly infrastructure invoice and payment confirmation for November
legitimateControls.text: Thank you for your payment. Your monthly statement for compute instances, object storage and network transfer has been paid in full via your registered corporate billing method. A detailed PDF breakdown of usage hours and tax accounting is available in the billing console.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Hardware order dispatched: workstation replacement delivery schedule
legitimateControls.text: Your IT equipment order has been dispatched from the regional distribution warehouse and is scheduled for office delivery on Wednesday afternoon. Someone at the reception desk will need to sign for the parcel upon arrival.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Platform security advisory: internal SSH certificate authority and TLS maintenance
legitimateControls.text: The infrastructure security engineering team will rotate the internal bastion host keys and intermediate TLS certificates during Saturday's scheduled maintenance window at 03:00 UTC. Please update your local workstation configuration from the engineering repository and report any connection issues in the incident channel.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Security confirmation: WebAuthn hardware token registered on your workstation account
legitimateControls.text: A new FIDO2 hardware security key was enrolled on your corporate directory profile during today's onboarding session. If you completed this registration with the IT helpdesk, no further action is required. Otherwise, contact the security operations desk immediately.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Payroll direct deposit advice and annual tax withholding summary
legitimateControls.text: Your biweekly salary statement and retirement plan contribution record have been posted to the employee self-service portal. Please verify your residential address and federal withholding elections before the year-end payroll processing cutoff.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Third-quarter departmental operating expense reconciliation and budget forecast
legitimateControls.text: Attached is the reconciled general ledger summary for engineering and operations through September. Please review the capital expenditure accruals and submit any cost-center adjustments to the accounting controller before Tuesday's close.

legitimateControls.label: ham
legitimateControls.subject: Protokoll der Architektur-Review und Freigabe des Wartungsfensters
legitimateControls.text: Hallo zusammen, die Ergebnisse der gestrigen Lasttests und der Sicherheitsprüfung liegen nun vollständig vor. Alle Dienste laufen stabil innerhalb der vereinbarten Grenzen. Bitte überprüft die offenen Aufgaben bis Donnerstagmittag.

legitimateControls.subject: 四半期システム監査および次期開発スケジュールのご連絡
legitimateControls.text: お疲れ様です。来週火曜日の午前十時より、定例の設計レビュー会議を開催いたします。事前に共有フォルダ内の技術仕様書とテスト計画をご確認いただけますようお願いいたします。

legitimateControls.subject: Recordatorio de consulta médica y revisión de tratamiento en la clínica
legitimateControls.text: Estimado paciente, le recordamos su próxima cita con el médico de cabecera el jueves a las 09:30 de la mañana. Por favor traiga su documento de identidad y la lista actualizada de sus medicamentos habituales.

legitimateControls.text: Please find your updated account and project review notes ready for tomorrow's session.
